# Feature: Combo catalyst art (white line-art)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-04 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Material → Formeln → Kombination recipe strips show the same white line-art for Katalysator (3rd slot) as Play/Material Katalysator cards. V6 `ueberladung` must not serve the leftover full-color PNG; orphan colored catalyst files from the z-image batch must not remain as resolve targets.

## Preconditions

- Branch `fix/combo-catalyst-art` from up-to-date `main` (after PR #401 white-catalyst restore)
- `public/cards/formula/ueberspannung.png` is white line-art
- V6 catalog recipes use `v6-katalysator-ueberladung` as catalyst id

## Happy Path

- [ ] `resolveFormulaCardArtPath('v6-katalysator-ueberladung')` → `/cards/formula/ueberspannung.png`
- [ ] Every V6 catalog recipe with a `catalystId` maps that slot via `resolveFormulaCardArtPath` to an existing white root formula PNG (no `z-image/`)
- [ ] `v6GeneratedRecipeToForgeCard` component strip for Überladung combos uses `ueberspannung.png` as the catalyst thumb
- [ ] Orphan full-color files `ueberladung.png`, `doppelecho.png`, `sicherheitsventil.png` are removed from `public/cards/formula/`

## Edge Cases

- [ ] V5 `v5-katalysator-ueberspannung` still resolves to `/cards/formula/ueberspannung.png`
- [ ] Playtest `beschwoerung` → `opfergabe` alias unchanged
- [ ] No reintroduction of `public/cards/formula/z-image/`

## Regression

- [ ] All other V6/V5 catalyst ids still resolve to existing `/cards/formula/<slug>.png`
- [ ] `npm run checks` green

## Assumptions

- V6 Überladung and V5 Überspannung share the same white line-art asset (rename/alias only; no new AI art).
- `doppelecho` / `sicherheitsventil` are not pack/catalog catalyst ids — safe to delete leftover colored PNGs.
